title: feat(shop_operations): collision-safe ids and material provenance (SHOP-OP-RECORD-HARDEN-002)
intent: Harden the merged SHOP-OP-RECORD-001 file-per-event record in place. Add a collision-safe default record id, require measurement provenance on newly written material lines, document the unit token rule and the authority boundary, and prove the package does not import CAM, readiness, G-code, or estimate code. Do not add verified job references, routes, or a second record model.
behavior_change: New writes are schema 1.1 and require material measurement provenance. Schema 1.0 files still load and re-save when the bytes are unchanged; they are not upgraded. make_operation_record can omit record_id and receive sop_{milliseconds}_{uuid4 hex}. Schema id is unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Default record ids use the MAINT-DEFER-019 millisecond-plus-uuid shape while caller-supplied ids remain valid. New writes are schema 1.1 and require a measured material source, recorder, observation time, and a source reference for imports. Schema 1.0 canonical bytes omit provenance, so pre-harden digests stay. Legacy lines report LEGACY_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE and are not rewritten. No schema id change, no route.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #464 is the canonical operation record. This increment does not add a second aggregate. It closes three gaps on that record: caller-only ids, material lines with no measurement provenance, and a missing authority-boundary document. Verified job references stay deferred to SHOP-JOB-REFERENCE-RESOLVER-001.
